title: echinopsis aurea subsp. fallax
intro: Echinopsis aurea subsp. fallax, commonly known as a type of cactus, is a species of cactus in the Echinopsis genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and having antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Echinopsis aurea subsp. fallax are attributed to its ability to interact with the nervous system, producing effects such as relaxation and improved mood, through its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Research has identified the presence of bioactive compounds like ergoloides and phenylethylamine in this plant, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
